scenes.text: Describe emotional changes and ways to make healthy choices
Strength: an ability or good quality we can develop. Empathy: trying to understand how another person feels.

Assertiveness: saying what you need firmly and respectfully. Personal hygiene: habits that help keep the body clean and healthy. Trusted adult: someone safe who listens and helps when we need support.
Write two strengths, one skill to improve and the name of a trusted adult.
